name: Create Purchase Order - Happy Path
objective: Create a new Standard Purchase Order for the given supplier, ordering the specified material/quantity at the negotiated net price, and capture the resulting Purchase Order number for downstream use.
preconditions: User is authorized to create purchase orders; the supplier and material are already maintained as master data.
learningObjectives: After this section you can create a Purchase Order from the Manage Purchase Orders app through to save.
After this section you can add a line item specifying material, plant, quantity, and net price.
After this section you can locate the system-generated Purchase Order number after saving.
commonErrorsAndTips: Supplier not authorized for the chosen purchasing organization. The system will flag the document incomplete; verify the supplier master record's purchasing view.
Leaving Net Price blank or zero. Some validations allow it but it results in a zero-value PO; always confirm the negotiated price is populated before saving.
Selecting the wrong Plant. Line item defaults may not match the intended receiving location; double-check Plant against the storage location you intend to receive into.
A typed material code that doesn't match a real master record can leave the row incomplete. Use the value-help dropdown result rather than assuming free-text entry always resolves.
